# Local Time System

> A TypeScript system for tracking time across fictional and real works — universes, epochs, keyframes, and cross-universe references.

### Personal Docs Site

> The Doks/Hugo site in personal/docs. Its pages are generated from this universe's timeline, so the documentation stems from one recorded source instead o…

- [Doks Scaffold](https://james-gibson.github.io/local-time/docs/site/docs/lore/personal-docs-2026/doks-scaffold/): The Doks template is scaffolded in personal/docs with the non-interactive create-thulite CLI. Part of the personal:docs:2026 timeline, bootstrap segment.
- [Toolchain Installed](https://james-gibson.github.io/local-time/docs/site/docs/lore/personal-docs-2026/toolchain-installed/): Hugo (extended) and Dart Sass are installed, so the theme's SCSS pipeline resolves. Part of the personal:docs:2026 timeline, bootstrap segment.
- [Docs Universe Declared](https://james-gibson.github.io/local-time/docs/site/docs/lore/personal-docs-2026/docs-universe-declared/): This universe is declared in lore and enrolled in the local-time sync. Part of the personal:docs:2026 timeline, bootstrap segment.
- [Content From Lore](https://james-gibson.github.io/local-time/docs/site/docs/lore/personal-docs-2026/content-from-lore/): The site's docs pages are generated from this timeline, so content stems from the universe rather than being authored beside it.
